findings.problem: Both proofs show that every fibre of `QuotientGroup.mk : G → G ⧸ H` is connected, and they do it separately. Each one inducts on the class `q = mk g`, identifies the fibre `mk ⁻¹' {mk g}` with the left translate `g • H`, and gets connectedness by transporting a connected set along continuous left translation by `g`. The first proof (lines 60–78) builds `range (fun h : H => g * h)` and proves the set equality by hand with `QuotientGroup.eq`, inverses and `convert`. The second (lines 166–173) uses `smul_connectedComponent` and a `rw` chain with `mem_smul_set_iff_inv_smul_mem`. The coset-fibre identification is the real shared content, and it is proved twice with different, fragile tactic scripts. The only difference is how connectedness of `(H : Set G)` is obtained.
findings.proposed_change:
Add one lemma in the first section, before `connectedSpace_of_quotient`:

`theorem isConnected_preimage_mk_singleton (H : Subgroup G) (hH : IsConnected (H : Set G)) (q : G ⧸ H) : IsConnected ((QuotientGroup.mk : G → G ⧸ H) ⁻¹' {q})`

Proof sketch: induct on `q` to get `q = mk g`. Show `mk ⁻¹' {mk g} = g • (H : Set G)`. Do this once with `ext x`, `QuotientGroup.eq` (`mk x = mk g ↔ g⁻¹ * x ∈ H`, after `eq_comm`) and `mem_smul_set_iff_inv_smul_mem`. Then `hH.image (g • ·) (continuous_const_smul g).continuousOn`, rewritten with `Set.image_smul`.

Use 1 (`connectedSpace_of_quotient`): replace the whole `hfiber` block with `have hfiber := isConnected_preimage_mk_singleton H hH`. Here `hH : IsConnected (H : Set G) := ⟨⟨1, H.one_mem⟩, by simpa using isPreconnected_range (continuous_subtype_val (p := (· ∈ H)))⟩`. It comes from `PreconnectedSpace H` through `Subtype.range_coe`, and `Set.range_nonempty` can replace the explicit `1` witness.

Use 2 (`totallyDisconnectedSpace_connectedComponentOfOne`): replace the `hfib` block with `have hfib := isConnected_preimage_mk_singleton N isConnected_connectedComponent`. This type-checks because `Subgroup.coe_connectedComponentOfOne` is `rfl`, so `(N : Set G)` unfolds to `connectedComponent 1`. The `hg` computation with `smul_connectedComponent` goes away.

The lemma needs only `ContinuousConstSMul G G`, which the first section already assumes. `IsTopologicalGroup G` supplies the same instance in the second section, so the lemma applies there.
findings.benefit: The coset-fibre identification and translation argument live in one place instead of two 10–20 line scripts. A future change, such as generalising to right cosets or monoid actions, is made once. Both call sites shrink to one-line applications that state their real input: the first supplies connectedness of `H` from `PreconnectedSpace H`, the second supplies connectedness of the identity component. The lemma's name and statement also document that these two theorems depend on the same fact.
